text:
Amira: quick design check — propose moving the 'Preview recent alerts' trigger inline under channel chips (instead of card footer) so it stays visible when suppression is toggled. Thoughts? :eyes:
Jon: agree, visibility is the problem right now. main worry: row density. can we do a micro-link for compact rows?
Selene: +1 micro-link. compact = text+icon, full = small secondary button. keep suppression toggle before preview in tab order.
Mark: keyboard flow callout: channels -> suppression -> preview. that way keyboard users can toggle suppression then preview without extra tabs.
Amira: noted. copy: prefer "Preview recent alerts" for expanded, and "Preview" for compact with tooltip "Preview recent alerts for selected channels".
A11y Bot: aria recs: trigger needs aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-label="Preview recent alerts for selected channels". add aria-live="polite" to preview results and announce "Preview updated: X results; Y channels suppressed".
Jon: dev note: lazy-load preview on click in compact lists and cache last successful preview for 30s. show a tiny "cached" dot when serving cached content.
Selene: UX edge: when suppression leads to zero results show "No recent alerts (suppressed)" and a link "Show suppressed sends" that toggles suppression in context. keyboard-focusable.
Mark: color/accessibility: micro-link must meet 4.5:1 at small text sizes or we bump to 14px; focus ring must be visible in both themes.
Amira: analytics: emit preview_open event with {"rule_id":"r_...","channels":[...],"suppressed":true/false,"variant":"compact|panel","cached":true/false,"result_count":int}.
Jon: I'll prototype compact link in storybook and wire the cached badge.
Selene: I'll update Figma and add a PR checklist: tab order, color contrast, aria-live checks, focus restore.
Amira: excellent — will add mock links to the PR and flag for keyboard QA. :white_check_mark:
